profile.headline: MSIT | BSSE | Software Engineer @ Miami-Dade County | Custom Software & BI Solutions  | Laravel | Power BI | Java
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and IT Professional with over 15 years of experience designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and innovative enterprise technology solutions across public and private sectors.

My expertise spans Full-Stack Software Development, Enterprise Application Architecture, Cloud Computing, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Systems Integration, and AI-powered solutions. I specialize in transforming complex business requirements into reliable, high-performance systems that enhance operational efficiency, support strategic decision-making, and drive digital transformation.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to enterprise modernization initiatives, mission-critical applications, data platforms, and complex system integrations. My technical background includes Laravel, Vue.js, PHP, JavaScript, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Azure, Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, RESTful APIs, and modern DevOps practices.

I bring an end-to-end perspective to the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution architecture to development, deployment, optimization, and continuous improvement. I collaborate with cross-functional teams, apply Agile methodologies, and deliver solutions focused on scalability, security, performance, and user experience.

I hold a Master of Science in Information Technology (MSIT), with a concentration in Application Development, from Nova Southeastern University, as well as a Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering.
I am passionate about Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, cloud-native applications, and emerging technologies that are transforming how organizations operate and innovate.

Core Areas of Expertise:
• Software Engineering & Enterprise Architecture
• Full-Stack Development & API Integration
• Microsoft Azure & Cloud Solutions
• Artificial Intelligence & Automation
• Data Engineering & Business Intelligence
• Enterprise Systems Integration
• Database Architecture & Optimization
• DevOps, CI/CD & Agile Methodologies

Driven by innovation, continuous learning, and a commitment to delivering technology solutions that create measurable business value.

projects.title: MDC WASD Data Warehouse & Reporting Site
projects.description:
ed the design and implementation of a robust Data Warehouse solution for the Water and Sewer Department (WASD), integrating data from multiple business systems to support enterprise-wide reporting and analytics.

This project involved developing several star schema models to reflect key Water Services operations. I contributed to the design of fact and dimension tables, and participated in the end-to-end ETL pipeline development using Azure Data Factory, ensuring seamless data transformation and integration from various source systems across WASD.

As part of the reporting layer, I built Power BI semantic models that directly mirrored the warehouse structures and business logic, enabling dynamic, user-friendly, and data-driven dashboards and reports. These reports are published in the Power BI Service and also embedded into a SharePoint portal (M2C Reporting Site) to facilitate easy access for business users.

To ensure collaboration and version control throughout the report development lifecycle, I established a Git-based version control system for Power BI assets, improving traceability and development workflows.
Key Responsibilities:
* Collaborated with stakeholders to gather and define report requirements.
* Designed and developed semantic models and Power BI reports.
* Managed and maintained the M2C SharePoint reporting portal.
* Supported continuous improvement and optimization of reporting infrastructure.

projects.title: GADIEL – Enterprise Business Management Suite
projects.description:
GADIEL is a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software suite architected to streamline and optimize critical business functions across diverse industries. Developed using a modern full-stack approach—Laravel for backend, Vue.js for frontend, and Node.js for real-time operations—GADIEL delivers a secure, scalable, and high-performance platform tailored for business process automation.

The application is modular and extensible, comprising core functionalities such as:

- Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
- E-commerce Integration
- Billing and Invoicing Automation
- Accounting and Financial Management
- Manufacturing Process Tracking
- Warehouse and Logistics Operations
- Project Lifecycle Management
- Advanced Inventory Control with Real-Time Stock Updates

The solution is designed with integration-first architecture, enabling seamless interoperability with third-party platforms such as Google Workspace, SquareUp, PayPal, and other RESTful/SOAP-based services. GADIEL is cloud-native, deployed on Amazon Web Services (AWS), and leverages services such as EC2, RDS, S3, and CloudFront to ensure high availability, redundancy, and elastic scaling.

Security is a cornerstone of GADIEL, with industry-standard encryption protocols, role-based access control (RBAC), and multi-tenant data isolation. The system supports API-first connectivity, making it highly adaptable to integrate with retail systems, online marketplaces, and legacy software.

GADIEL positions itself as a robust and secure digital backbone for modern enterprises, enabling operational agility and digital transformation through centralized management and data-driven decision-making.
